prompt: A line of best fit is $y = 3x + 8$. One data point in the scatterplot is $(6, 30)$. What is the residual for that data point?
hint: A residual measures how far a data point is from the line. Recall which value is subtracted from which.

hints.text: A residual measures how far a data point is from the line. Recall which value is subtracted from which.
The line predicts $y = 3(6) + 8 = 26$ when $x = 6$, while the actual value is $30$. Subtract the predicted value from the actual value.
The residual is $30 - 26 = 4$, so the residual for that point is $4$.

learningObjective: Compute a residual from a model and an observed point.
explanation: Find the value the line predicts at $x = 6$: $y = 3(6) + 8 = 26$.
The actual value comes from the data point itself, and it is $30$.
The residual is actual minus predicted, $30 - 26 = 4$. It is positive because the point lies above the line, so the residual is $4$.

alternativeExplanations.title: The sign carries meaning
steps: Positive residual: the actual value is above the line, so the model under-predicted.
Negative residual: the point is below the line, so the model over-predicted.
Computing predicted minus actual reverses the sign and gives $-4$ — which will be an answer choice.
